as_told.title: Sitchin's Anunnaki genetic experiments on primate ancestors

plain: The claim is that the Anunnaki, gods of the ancient Sumerian myths, engineered humans as a slave race on Earth. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it, saying "the Sumerian myths tell us that when the Anunnaki engineered a slave race on Earth," and he credits the writer Zecharia Sitchin, who read those texts this way. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, also credits Sitchin, but in his version the Anunnaki "performed genetic experiments on our primate ancestors," with no mention of slaves. Both tellers draw on Sitchin's reading of the Sumerian texts and quote none of the texts themselves. If it were true, humanity would be the deliberate product of beings from elsewhere.
